name: On Iron Pauldrons
summary: Orokk Omosh in Orgrimmar asks you to bring him bronze weapons. Four battleaxes and four warhammers are needed.

sections.title: A smith's request
sections.body: Orokk Omosh awaits you in Orgrimmar. He asks for four Bronze Battleaxes and four Bronze Warhammers, and the weapons are the reason he has called for you.

faq.answer: Orokk Omosh asks you to bring four Bronze Battleaxes and four Bronze Warhammers.

faq.q: Where do I take the weapons?
faq.answer: Bring the Bronze Battleaxes and Bronze Warhammers to Orokk Omosh in Orgrimmar.

faq.q: How many battleaxes does Orokk want?
faq.answer: Orokk Omosh asks for four Bronze Battleaxes.

faq.q: How many warhammers does Orokk want?
faq.answer: Orokk Omosh asks for four Bronze Warhammers.

attribution: In-game quest text: On Iron Pauldrons
